modules.title: Introduction to Civic Duties and Responsibilities
modules.html:
Voting, paying taxes, loyalty, obedience to law and community service. This section covers introduction to civic duties and responsibilities.

Key points

  • The ultimate goal of civic education is to produce _____. — Responsible and effective citizens.
  • Civic Responsibility: — Pay tax.
  • Citizenship duties: — Obey laws.
  • One of the duties of a citizen is: — Payment of taxes.
  • Citizen duties: — Pay tax/Obey law.

Worked examples

Q: The ultimate goal of civic education is to produce _____.
A: Responsible and effective citizens — Civic education aims to equip citizens with the knowledge and values necessary to contribute positively to their society.

Q: Civic Responsibility:
A: Pay tax — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Pay tax.

quiz.q: The ultimate goal of civic education is to produce _____.
quiz.solution: Civic education aims to equip citizens with the knowledge and values necessary to contribute positively to their society.

quiz.q: Civic Responsibility:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Pay tax.

quiz.q: Citizenship duties:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Obey laws.

quiz.q: One of the duties of a citizen is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Payment of taxes.

quiz.q: Citizen duties:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Pay tax/Obey law.

quiz.q: Which is a civic responsibility?
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Payment of tax.

quiz.q: A major characteristic of the civil service is 'Anonymity', which means _____.
options: Civil servants are not to be blamed or praised for government policies
Civil servants must hide their faces
Civil servants can join any political party
quiz.solution: Anonymity means that civil servants work behind the scenes; the political head (Minister/Commissioner) takes the credit or blame for policy outcomes.

quiz.q: The display of a high level of moral uprightness and honesty is _____.
quiz.solution: Integrity is the practice of being honest and showing a consistent and uncompromising adherence to strong moral and ethical principles.

quiz.q: Which of the following is a duty of a Nigerian citizen?
quiz.solution: Payment of taxes is an obligatory duty of every citizen to enable the government to provide infrastructure and services.

quiz.q: The black shield on the Nigerian Coat of Arms represents _____.
quiz.solution: The black shield represents Nigeria's fertile soil, which is a major agricultural asset.

quiz.q: A core value that helps in preventing corruption is _____.
quiz.solution: Integrity involves being honest and having strong moral principles, making an individual resistant to corrupt practices.

quiz.q: Orderliness in a queue means _____.
quiz.solution: Waiting for one's turn demonstrates discipline and respect for social order.

quiz.q: Which article of the UDHR states that 'Everyone has the right to life, liberty and security of person'?
quiz.solution: Article 3 of the UDHR covers the foundational right to life and physical safety of every individual.

quiz.q: The agency responsible for safety on Nigerian roads is the _____.
quiz.solution: The Federal Road Safety Corps (FRSC) is the lead government agency for road safety administration and traffic management in Nigeria.

quiz.q: A state of harmony where there is no war or disturbance is called _____.
quiz.solution: Peace is the absence of hostility and the presence of social order and mutual understanding.

quiz.q: The primary goal of the UDHR is to _____.
options: Protect the rights of the wealthy
Promote global peace and human dignity
quiz.solution: The UDHR serves as a blueprint for world peace by ensuring every human is treated with dignity and fairness.

quiz.q: HIV can be transmitted through _____.
quiz.solution: Sharing needles or blades contaminated with infected blood is a primary mode of HIV transmission.

quiz.q: FRSC manages:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Road safety.

quiz.q: Freedom of Press:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Media rights.

quiz.q: Integrity means:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Honesty and moral soundness.

quiz.q: Which of these is an agency of socialization?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: All of the above.

quiz.q: The 1999 Constitution is the:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Supreme law.

quiz.q: Cultism leads to:

quiz.q: Discipline involves:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Self-control.

quiz.q: Contentment involves...
options: Being satisfied with what one has legally acquired
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Being satisfied with what one has legally acquired.

quiz.q: A major problem of the Nigerian public service is...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Bureaucracy and corruption.

quiz.q: The agency that conducts elections in Nigeria is...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: INEC.

quiz.q: NAPTIP is the agency responsible for prohibition of:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Trafficking in persons.

quiz.q: In the constitution, the Fourth Estate of the Realm refers to the:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Press/Media.

quiz.q: Legislature:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Makes laws.

quiz.q: UDHR articles:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: 30.

quiz.q: Green light in traffic means:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Go.

quiz.q: Sovereignty belongs to:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: The people/State.
